Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Elite Chiropractic and Performance.  We are a sports and rehab based chiropractic clinic located in Chesterfield, MO.  Our goal is to incorporate functional movement and rehab with strength and conditioning to get our patients better, faster. 

Dr. Chris Collier is a sports based chiropractor in the state of Missouri.  He has had extensive training in soft tissue and manual therapy, functional rehab, and functional movement.  He is a Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) as well as a Titleist Performance Institute (TPI) Certified Level 3 Medical Professional and Level 2 Fitness Professional.
